card.name: Nouns just before a repeated reference
card.fires_on: A common noun or verb in general web text (idea, plane, pond, roof, lake, enable) that is the head of a phrase and is likely to be followed by a pronoun or by words that refer back to it. It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Object nouns
modes.description: A concrete or abstract noun naming a thing that is then described or referred to again.

modes.label: Code and action words
modes.description: A verb or method name in programming comments, followed by 'it' or a similar reference.

card.plain: It marks an ordinary noun or verb in general web text that the sentence goes on to refer back to.
